title: Band-9 Samples: What do you do if you can’t get to sleep at night? [Why?]
passage_text: This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 18 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 3 Test 4 question: “What do you do if you can’t get to sleep at night? [Why?]” Sample 1 Female Male In those rare instances when I’m unable to catch some shut-eye, I resort to engaging in a low-stimulus activity, such as reading a book or doing a light stretch. This approach helps me to unwind and detach from any stressors or preoccupations that may be impeding my sleep. Once I feel sufficiently relaxed, I return to my bed, and more often than not, I find that sleep comes to me with greater ease. Sample 2 Female Male At times when sleep proves to be a challenge, I prefer to indulge in a soothing nighttime ritual, such as sipping on a cup of warm chamomile tea. This beverage is renowned for its calming properties, and consuming it can signal to my body and mind that it’s time to unwind and prepare for rest. Additionally, the warmth of the tea serves as a comforting sensation, fostering a sense of serenity that enables me to drift off more easily. Sample 3 Female Male When I experience difficulty in catching some shut-eye, I find solace in listening to tranquil, ambient music or nature sounds. These soothing auditory stimuli help to create a serene environment that is conducive to relaxation. By drowning out any external noise or distracting thoughts, I can effortlessly ease myself into a peaceful slumber. Sample 4 Female Male When confronted with insomnia, I sometimes find it useful to adjust my sleep environment to promote relaxation and comfort. This could involve modifying the room temperature, investing in a high-quality mattress or pillow, and using blackout curtains to block out any external light. By optimizing my surroundings, I can create the ideal conditions for sleep, which can prove instrumental in combating insomnia and ensuring a restorative night’s rest. Sample 5 Female Male If I find myself tossing and turning at night, unable to drift off into slumber, I often resort to a traditional technique called counting sheep. This method involves visualizing sheep jumping over a fence, and mentally counting them as they pass. The repetitive nature of this activity helps to calm my mind and disengage from any intrusive thoughts that might be keeping me awake. By focusing on the simple, monotonous task of counting, my brain gradually succumbs to drowsiness, allowing me to finally succumb to a restful sleep. Sample 6 Female Male In instances where sleep eludes me, one strategy that I often adopt is to simply keep my eyes shut and resist the urge to peek. By doing so, I create a serene and tranquil environment that allows my mind to unwind and gradually transition into a state of repose. This method is particularly effective for me, as it eliminates distractions and enables me to focus solely on the process of falling asleep. Sample 7 Female Male Whenever I experience insomnia, I find it helpful to practice gratitude by reflecting on the positive aspects of my life. By focusing on the things I’m grateful for and acknowledging my accomplishments, I can shift my mindset away from any negative thoughts or stressors that may be hindering my sleep. This practice not only promotes a sense of contentment but also fosters an overall sense of well-being, making it easier to fall asleep. Sample 8 Female Male During nights when sleep is difficult to attain, I find it beneficial to employ visualization techniques as a means to relax my mind. By imagining a serene and peaceful environment, such as a secluded beach or a tranquil forest, I can mentally transport myself to a calming setting. This mental escape helps to alleviate any lingering stress or anxiety, making it easier for me to drift off into a restful sleep. Sample 9 Female Male If I struggle to fall asleep at night, I opt for a late-night noodle snack as a way to cope with insomnia. Eating noodles in the nighttime has become a sort of ritual for me – the process of boiling water, cooking the noodles, and adding my preferred ingredients can be quite meditative, which helps me clear my mind of any intrusive thoughts or worries. The gentle aroma and satisfying texture of the noodles further contribute to an atmosphere of tranquility, ultimately guiding me towards a peaceful night’s rest. Sample 10 Female Male When I encounter difficulties falling asleep at night, one technique I employ is to distance myself from electronic devices, particularly my mobile phone. The rationale behind this is that the blue light emitted from screens is notorious for disrupting our natural sleep cycles. By putting away my phone, I not only minimize distractions but also create an environment conducive to rest and relaxation.
